messages:
Ava L: quick design review — noticed ghost buttons on dark surfaces are getting a blown-out focus halo when tabbing into them. screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/ghost-focus.png :eyes:
Samir: repro steps: open /console/settings -> open user modal -> tab to footer action row -> ghost button gets a full outer ring that overlaps the rounded corner. Happens in both compact and default densities.
Priya: can confirm. appears worse on 8px corner radius cards. likely because we use an outer-shadow focus token instead of inset.
Miguel: idea — switch to an inset focus for ghost buttons on dark surfaces so the ring doesn't overflow the border radius. ie. use `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--focus-opa)` for dark surfaces.
Ava L: agreed. small CSS token proposal to try in the system:```
--rwd-focus-outer: 0 0 0 2px rgba(33,150,243,0.18);
--rwd-focus-inset: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
.ghost-btn { box-shadow: var(--rwd-focus-inset); }
```
Priya: also flag: keyboard order regresses when table row actions collapse into kebab on narrow screens. Tab sequence goes row -> kebab -> open menu -> focus lands in modal header (if you open a modal) instead of the first interactive in the modal. users expect modal focus to be trapped to modal start.
Samir: sounds like we lose the focus trap when the kebab menu triggers a modal via JS. probable cause: we call `focus()` on the modal wrapper before it's mounted, or the trap library isn't initialized because the opener still holds aria-hidden=false.
Miguel: quick patch suggestion: when opening modal from transient UI (kebab or row action) first call `requestAnimationFrame` then `focus()` the first tabbable inside modal, and ensure `bodyAriaHidden(true)` runs before focus.
Ava L: ux question: for toasts triggered by table actions (like "Copied" or "Deleted"), they currently appear top-right and cause visual overlap with the inline action strip. On dense tables that feels noisy. should toasts float above or push content? :thinking_face:
Priya: prefer toasts float above and avoid pushing table layout. but we should nudge their vertical offset when an action strip is open: `--toast-offset-y: calc(var(--toast-base-offset) + var(--action-strip-height))`. keeps layout stable but avoids overlap.
DesignBot: automated a11y scan: `ghost-btn` hover contrast on dark surface = 3.9:1 (fail, needs >=4.5:1) — consider boosting hover fill or adding a subtle underline for non-primary ghost actions. :robot_face:
Samir: actionable plan: 1) change ghost focus to inset on dark surfaces (PR in draft) 2) add small animation frame delay + ensure aria-hidden toggle for modal open path 3) adjust toast offset token and add a small responsive rule for dense tables 4) run a11y scan + manual keyboard test across modal->kebab->table flows.
Ava L: awesome. I'll update the token spec and add a short design note + screenshots for before/after. assigning follow-ups: @Samir PR, @Priya keyboard test, @Miguel toast token change. thanks! :thumbsup:
